note: TinyMind v2 STAGE-1 objective: language acquisition. Evaluated by the trainer on the LIVE model at every evaluation checkpoint; the stage completes only when EVERY measurement below passes after the minimum token budget (configs/curriculum_v2.json target_tokens), nothing regressed against the previous checkpoint, and never on validation loss alone. Measurements are independent: held-out loss on the curriculum validation split (ceiling mirrors stage1.gate.json so the stage cannot complete and then fail its own promotion gate on the same number); natural held-out text in BITS PER BYTE (tokenizer-independent: the same threshold means the same thing for a byte-level or a 16k-BPE model); greedy continuations of the fixed prompts below scored for emptiness, length, repetition/looping and diversity; grammar checks (real words from the training-corpus lexicon, sentence capitals, punctuation spacing); and a data requirement so language is never declared acquired from a placeholder corpus. Every number is a policy knob set as a FLOOR before the first full-budget pass (an untrained model scores ~8 bits/byte with a byte tokenizer, ~3.3 with 16k BPE, and emits looping byte noise); tighten after the first pass. Size-specific thresholds: copy this directory and pass --objective-dir (or set objective_dir in the model profile); the code does not change.
